criteria.review_note: Full frozen root input/helper/profile/package/shape versions and phase timings bind the diagnosis.
Repeated property/list meta-SHACL expansion dominates; list-only attempts remain failed, while full constraint sharing completes without changed semantics.

Final actual root full SHACL completes on 3,413 triples. The final populated delivered project has 191 records and 3,642 full-scope triples (2,606 asserted, 1,012 derived, 24 external) and completes conformantly; the audited 2,268 asserted-triple root baseline remains explicitly accounted for.
Root budget remains 10 seconds and guard decision remains 5 seconds; full measured completion, not an increased timeout, supports the remedy.
Before/after comparison retains all 191 targets and 2,346 expanded constraints; 15 semantic cases per version and shipped regressions preserve domain/range/cardinality/source/shape/graph outcomes.
Shared immutable full-constraint construction is rebuilt from current inputs. Full-root validation and ground/blank-node equivalence exclude empty/sampled graphs or weakened constraints.
Timeout and cancellation controls terminate audit-owned workers with complete=false; guard tests preserve the no-owner-after-failure boundary.
Certified resource/output/query controls remain finite. Ground RDF normalization reduces the observed five-second guard decision to about 2.18 seconds without changing limits.
Common health schema v2 states scope, level, aggregate and required failures; focused CLI controls and final root operational output agree.
Canonical readiness remains visible; neutral static capability and deliberately disabled/unselected profiles are reported separately from runtime execution.
Source fault controls and final installed memory suite verify required nested failure gives nonzero; final live passing required scopes return zero.
Invalid request/root/missing configuration are distinguished, and documented compatibility aliases preserve component detail and optional profile treatment.
Required operational checks use actual bounded local backends and explicit loopback identity; selected missing/stale/unexercised runtime fails the controls.
Assessment time and input versions accompany health. Initializer receipts label static capability and unselected runtime distinctly; version drift controls invalidate readiness.
Health/evidence controls cover absent/stale/invalid/unsupported/unavailable/timeout/disabled states with component and source diagnostics.
Durable evidence retains nested artifact expected/current versions; missing/tampered evidence fails closed without automatic repair or credential output.
Guard readiness checks current bootstrap, engine, adapter, family and standards bindings; changed/missing/incomplete controls fail. The exact amended root binding is separately observed.
Live binding inspection enumerates all declared families; non-mutating health and actual fixture dispatch coverage remain separate evidence levels.
Stopped/wrong-project/malformed/trickling service controls and actual matching owned loopback service are observed with bounded deadlines.
Health starts no service; separately owned live services are closed. No persistent-session or continuous-service readiness is claimed.
Static and negative controls preserve fixture state; the final live audit preserves all 6,198 scoped canonical/helper/runtime/derived files.
All 6,199 raw snapshots are retained: only independent Template watcher telemetry changed. Explicit bounded runtime/service probes and cleanup are separately identified.
Original immutable receipt, raw logs and historical helper bytes remain retained with exact provenance.
Governed historical successors are published through exact grants and receipts; record validation reports four readable records and zero verified-current records, avoiding a renewed current claim.
Exact archived observations remain supported historical evidence despite later code changes; current applicability is separately unverified or changed.
Missing/tampered proof and direct-source drift controls fail closed; final historical queries do not promote the records into current authority.
Source-version mutation controls preserve earlier archived evidence while invalidating unsupported current applicability; new direct-source controls enforce actual retained bytes.
Reviewed companions use the existing governed evidence scope and immutable proof hashes. Unsupported receipt, locator and retained-content controls prevent synthetic renewal.
Declared dependency controls cover changed documents, lifecycle/content, ontology helpers/definitions, profile configuration and model/index inputs.
Previously built missing/stale/altered products fail health; final selected derived products are current. Lexical fallback does not turn stale associations into trusted evidence.
Exact guarded root reindex and compile/wiki/link/semantic operations run after adopted helpers and governed history settle.
Final root hybrid retrieval and operational health pass with current inputs and empty limitations; governed historical records are included or excluded according to lifecycle and applicability.

Version-bound post-write verification and final maintenance run in dependency order. Final core, advanced and memory health reopen ready after delivery; the frozen classified baseline comparison binds the final versions.
Source tests demonstrate committed publication with out-of-scope pending maintenance and interrupted recovery. Read-only checks do not grant mutation authority.

Source, installed, Template and deep-space layout controls use documented entry points. The actual relocated delivered ordinary suite passes all 183 tests with explicit standards, semantic-root and depot selections.
Resolved macOS fixture roots and relocated-copy tests pass without hidden imports/ancestor fallback or weakened production alias rules.

Source, root installed, and deep relocated delivered suites each pass all 183 required identities, including every original 153 identity, with actual selected semantic acceptance and no required skips.

Shipped runner and ordinary unittest entry point require no audit wrapper/import patch. SYS4AI_TEST_DEPOT_ROOT, SYS4AI_STANDARDS_PYTHON and SYS4AI_SEMANTIC_ACCEPTANCE_ROOT are explicit existing-resource selections.
Exact per-identity outcomes and commands are retained; original 153-test failed direct run, later partial runs and successful selected runs stay distinct.
Coverage injection controls reject missing identity, required skip and setup error, while explicitly unselected optional skips are permitted.
Shipped ontology/memory fault regressions and health review controls cover the required matrix; final installed ontology 183 and memory 94 tests pass, binding the current delivered helper versions.
Controls assert cause, aggregate/detail/CLI result and preservation. Actual local backend/semantic observations are distinguished from static and injected fixture evidence.
Final source inventory includes 59 exact root owners plus the Template-only contract test; all source/root hashes match the effective reviewed manifest.

Final explicit Template check/apply/check and 12-test contract pass, followed by a current post-delivery check. Exact initial and amended root adoption receipts retain the original scope and narrow maintenance repair.
Delivered neutral matrix must show specialized identity, empty project history/extensions and intentionally disabled optional profiles.

Supported governed starter delivery excludes source records, projections, models, virtual environments, certificates, bootstraps and sessions. The raw whole-directory compatibility control intentionally retains and reports a pre-existing unmanaged Template .venv; it is unselected legacy content, not an initializer-created runtime or runtime-readiness claim.
Trusted static package/lock/contract/identity/binding assessment passes complete packages and rejects unknown target execution; only exact reviewed pure inspectors may execute.
Selected required failures return partial/nonzero; preserved customized excluded capability keeps its base receipt but static_ready=false/degraded. Copy success cannot assert capability readiness.
Final root operational profiles and hybrid backend use current configuration, certificates, guard bindings and derived state with bounded real probes.
Negative controls reject missing/stale/timeout/wrong-project prerequisites. Current root and delivered initiation are observed separately; no installation or repair authority comes from health reads.

Root adoption is explicitly limited to the final 59-file manifest with earlier receipt retained. All 433 protected baseline files remain unchanged; 49 added worktree paths are individually classified, with no unclassified delta.

Initializer controls and final delivered scenarios preserve earlier editions, custom/incomplete assets, history, capture-off/disabled choices, licenses and unrelated files or return an explicit conflict. The raw-copy legacy runtime is preserved and reported rather than silently adopted.
Equivalent setup/adoption reruns preserve existing choices and avoid duplicates or implicit new-edition adoption.
Source/target conflict and interrupted exact-recovery controls preserve original receipt provenance; a prior completed receipt is not used as current capability health.

Final delivered CLI evidence covers fresh, manual/first preparation, deep/relocated, populated, reconstructed earlier-edition adoption, preserved choices, equivalent rerun and interrupted exact recovery; the earlier-edition case is explicitly a reconstruction.

Neutral static checks use no provisioning. The populated delivered project explicitly activates standards and inference with existing copied runtime and observes complete queries/full SHACL/trusted inference. Its relocated installed suite runs actual semantic acceptance using the explicit shared root; other fixture-local profiles remain unselected.

All 27 original live command routes plus four operational/historical checks return zero on final root; full SHACL, queries, inference, semantic, memory, guards and owned workbench behavior are observed.

F1-F6 map to observed results while original failures remain intact. Final preservation classifies all baseline deltas and 49 new worktree paths. The live raw snapshot changes only independently observed watcher telemetry; scoped canonical/helper/runtime/derived bytes and mtimes are preserved.
Source/root/Template documentation parity binds scope, v2 aggregate/exit meanings, historical applicability, runtime selections and explicit repair instructions.
This review maps evidence without changing canonical plan status or claiming host acceptance, publication, a continuous service or guarantees for every future installation.
